title: The Secret of Secrets
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: In Prague, Robert Langdon attends a lecture by scientist Katherine Solomon, whose groundbreaking work on consciousness could overturn established beliefs. When a murder occurs and Katherine vanishes with her manuscript, Langdon follows a dangerous trail of symbols and secrets.

title: Before the Coffee Gets Cold
author: Toshikazu Kawaguchi
synopsis: At a small Tokyo cafe, visitors can travel through time under strict rules, including returning before their coffee gets cold. Four intertwined stories explore the conversations people wish they could have and the ways those moments can change them.

title: After the Darkness
author: Tilly Bagshawe
synopsis: Grace Brookstein leads a privileged life until her financier husband dies and his business is exposed as a massive fraud. Blamed for crimes she did not understand, Grace fights to uncover the truth and reclaim her life.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: After a curator is murdered at the Louvre, symbologist Robert Langdon and cryptologist Sophie Neveu decode clues hidden in art and history while evading forces determined to protect an ancient religious secret.

title: The Lost Symbol
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: Robert Langdon is drawn into a race through Washington, D.C., when his mentor Peter Solomon is kidnapped. Cryptic Masonic symbols and hidden histories lead him toward a secret that could change everything.

title: The Doomsday Conspiracy
author: Sidney Sheldon
synopsis: Naval intelligence officer Robert Bellamy is ordered to locate witnesses to a mysterious crash in Switzerland. As his investigation spans multiple countries, he discovers that powerful forces are hiding far more than a weather balloon accident.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
synopsis: Santiago, a young Andalusian shepherd, journeys toward the Egyptian pyramids in search of a treasure he has seen in a dream. Along the way, he learns about love, destiny, and the value of following his own path.

title: I Am Number Four
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: John Smith, a teenager hiding in a small Ohio town, is one of nine survivors from the planet Lorien. As the Mogadorians hunt the Garde down in numerical order, he realizes he is next and must master his emerging powers.

title: The Power of Six
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: With three of the Garde dead, the survivors are scattered across the world. John runs with Sam and Six while Number Seven hides in Spain, and each learns more about their legacies and the enemy closing in.

title: The Rise of Nine
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: John, Six and Sam search for Number Nine in New York while the Mogadorians tighten their grip. The Garde begin to come together, but their reunion draws even more dangerous attention.

title: The Fall of Five
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: The reunited Garde gather strength and allies as the Mogadorian threat grows. Old loyalties are tested and a betrayal shakes the group at a crucial moment.

title: The Revenge of Seven
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: The Garde fight to stay ahead of the Mogadorian invasion while searching for the means to stand against it. The cost of the war grows heavier for every survivor.

title: The Fate of Ten
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: The Garde step up their fight to protect Earth as the Mogadorian leader prepares his final moves. The survivors must trust one another and push their powers to their limits.

title: United as One
author: Pittacus Lore
synopsis: The final battle for Earth arrives as the surviving Garde and their human allies face the Mogadorian forces. The fate of both Lorien's legacy and humanity hangs on the outcome.

title: Angels & Demons
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: Called to examine a mysterious symbol at a Swiss research center, Robert Langdon uncovers a plot against the Catholic Church. He races through Rome and Vatican City to stop a deadly threat connected to the Illuminati.

title: Inferno
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: Robert Langdon wakes in a Florence hospital with no memory of recent events and soon finds himself pursued by dangerous enemies. Following clues rooted in Dante's Inferno, he must unravel a plot with global consequences.

title: Origin
author: Dan Brown
synopsis: At a high-profile event in Bilbao, futurist Edmond Kirsch prepares to reveal a discovery about humanity's origins and future. When the presentation is disrupted, Robert Langdon and museum director Ambra Vidal search Spain for the key to Kirsch's secret.

title: A Wanted Man
author: Lee Child
synopsis: Jack Reacher accepts a ride from three strangers while hitchhiking toward Virginia. A nearby murder investigation reveals that his fellow travelers are involved in a dangerous conspiracy, and nobody is telling the whole truth.

title: Personal
author: Lee Child
synopsis: After an attempt on the French president's life, Jack Reacher is recruited to track a former military sniper he once helped imprison. With a major international summit approaching, Reacher pursues the killer across Europe.

title: Ten Little Indians
author: Agatha Christie
synopsis: Ten strangers gather on a remote island at the invitation of an unseen host. When they are accused of past crimes and begin dying one by one, the survivors realize that the killer must be among them. Also published as And Then There Were None.

title: Killing Floor
author: Lee Child
synopsis: Former military policeman Jack Reacher arrives in the town of Margrave, Georgia, and is promptly arrested for murder. Determined to clear his name, he investigates the killing and uncovers a violent criminal operation.

title: Mr. Mercedes
author: Stephen King
synopsis: A killer who drove a stolen Mercedes into a crowd taunts retired detective Bill Hodges with messages hinting that he may strike again. Hodges and unlikely allies race to stop him before he carries out an even deadlier attack.

title: The Lost Hero
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: Jason, Piper and Leo arrive at Camp Half-Blood after a school trip goes terribly wrong. Jason has lost his memory, and the trio is sent on a quest to free Hera and head off a rising threat.

title: The Son of Neptune
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: Percy Jackson wakes with no memory and is drawn to Camp Jupiter, the Roman demigods' home. With Hazel and Frank, he sets out on a perilous quest north to Alaska.

title: The Mark of Athena
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: Seven Greek and Roman demigods sail the Argo II toward Rome in a race against Gaea. Tension between the two camps and Annabeth's own quest threaten to tear the crew apart.

title: The House of Hades
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: Percy and Annabeth struggle through Tartarus in search of the Doors of Death while the rest of the crew races to meet them. Each side must survive to close the doors before Gaea rises.

title: The Blood of Olympus
author: Rick Riordan
synopsis: The seven demigods make their final push to stop Gaea from awakening fully, while the Greek and Roman camps edge toward open war. The heroes must unite to save Olympus and the world.

title: The Sacred Sword
author: Scott Mariani
synopsis: After two old friends die in a suspicious crash, former SAS soldier Ben Hope investigates their research into a mysterious ancient sword. The search takes him across countries as he uncovers the deadly secret behind the relic.

title: Twelve Red Herrings
author: Jeffrey Archer
synopsis: A collection of twelve short stories about schemes, betrayals, ambition, love, and murder. Each tale plays with expectations and challenges readers to spot the misleading clue before the twist.

title: Over My Dead Body
author: Jeffrey Archer
synopsis: Detective William Warwick joins a London unit dedicated to unsolved murders. As several old cases converge with the schemes of an elusive art criminal, Warwick must catch killers who believe they got away with their crimes.

title: The Cassandra Sanction
author: Scott Mariani
synopsis: Ben Hope agrees to help a grieving brother investigate his scientist sister's apparent suicide. Their search uncovers suspicious deaths, professional assassins, and a far-reaching conspiracy meant to deceive the world.
